notes.title: Within the Unknown Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Updates:[/h1]
[list]
*Fixed many bugs
[/list][list]*Slightly buffed the lighter
[/list][list]
*Updated the cornfield and AI
[/list][list]
*Altered events in the house and driving sequence
[/list][list]
*More functionality when lighting candles
[/list][list]
*Fixed drawers glitch
[/list][list]
*Attempting to fix new game bug and graphics settings
[/list][list]
*Attempting to fix losing your lighter after driving sequence
[/list]
[h2]In Addition[/h2]
     
I would like to mention the game will not be released in chapters. It will be released as a full game.

This is my first game so I'm still learning and making decisions as I go so sorry if some things came off misleading lol

I hope you enjoy this version of the demo and stay tuned for the full game! ːsteamhappyː
